Changed sign of the forcing to remove inertial oscillations in documentation page internal_tide.jl.
Previously, the initial condition was not consistent with the barotropic tide forcing, which was creating an inertial oscillation at t>0. See the attached PDF for the math. 

[Barotropic_Internal_Tides.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34995433/Barotropic_Internal_Tides.pdf)
